_note: Interior decorators you can hire at home. Real players with the Interior decorator job do it first (they set their fee within the limits, accept your key and finish the job with a finishing touch); if none is free, or none picks up your key within acceptMinutes, a Local studio does it. Each studio has one look (a floor finish, a wall paint and panelling, and pieces from the furniture catalogue in src/lib/furniture.ts) and three finishing touches the decorator chooses from. You pay the finish and pieces up front, plus a player decorator's fee (held until they finish). Studios are fictional; each Local decorator is the Local of that name (src/lib/locals.ts). The career, fee limits, interview answers, timings and touches are mirrored in supabase/migrations/*_decorators.sql (scripts/check-life-config.mjs).

interview.q: A client wants their small studio to feel bigger. You…
options: Fill it with dark, heavy furniture
Use light colours, mirrors and fewer, well-placed pieces
Paint every wall a different colour

interview.q: A client's budget is AED 10,000 but they love a AED 38,000 piano. You…
options: Show options that fit the budget and explain the trade-offs

interview.q: You're handed the client's key. You…
options: Use it only for the job and give it back when you're done
